name: Code Candy Auth Overlay Slide
useWhen: A project needs a clean light auth card where an overlay slides between sign-in and create-account panels on explicit click.
preferredStack: Motion for React when integrating into React
implementationNotes: Keep the create-account form visible and unobstructed after the slide.
Avoid rendering vertical artifacts at the overlay seam by sizing and translating the overlay deliberately.
Use real accessible inputs, submit handling, validation, and secure auth in production.
Keep source-video code frames out of previews.
reducedMotion: Swap the overlay side instantly with no slide animation and maintain focus order.
avoid: overlay seams or clipped submit buttons
